_meta.doc: DERIVED by tools/build_manifest.py --lay from `git ls-files --stage`; never hand-edited. Executed by install/lay.py. Bound to the tree by voidloom/tests/test_lay_manifest.py. derived_at_head is the HEAD at derivation time -- the PARENT of the commit that carries this file, never that commit (a file cannot name the commit it is part of); --check ignores it.

voidloom/tests/.reason: the package's test suite is a CHECKOUT surface: it derives its population from `git ls-files` and skips or refuses outside a checkout, so it is run from the package, never from a laid brain; and its gate files necessarily carry the needles and planted faults they gate. Runtime self-tests live in organs/.

_meta.self_entries_reason: a manifest cannot carry its own hash, and the two derived inventories cannot hash each other without a cycle; lay.py lays both and reports them unhashed by name
